tagline: A global additives and specialty ingredients company with a conscious and proactive mindset for sustainability.
hero_kpi_rationale: Ashland is a global company with 73% of its sales generated outside North America, reflecting its diversified geographic reach and growing reliance on international markets.

kpis.name: AI / Cloud Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from activities related to artificial intelligence or cloud computing.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the contribution of AI and cloud-related solutions and services to the company's overall revenue.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of growth in emerging technology areas.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key indicator of financial health and operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Indicates profitability of products and services before accounting for other expenses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects the company's ability to generate profit from its core operations.
kpis.signal: Measures profitability of the company's primary operations.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Sustained R&D investment is critical for long-term competitiveness in the additives and specialty ingredients sector.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation and new product development.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.description: Capex is an indicator of the company's growth and expansion strategy.
kpis.signal: Reflects investments in production capacity and infrastructure.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is an indicator of operational capacity and human resource management strategy.
kpis.signal: Indicates the size of the organization and its potential for growth or rationalization.

kpis.name: Sales Outside North America
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated outside North America.
kpis.description: A high proportion of international sales can reduce dependence on a single market.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's geographic reach and market diversification.

kpis.name: Life Sciences Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue generated by the Life Sciences segment.
kpis.description: This KPI shows the contribution of the Life Sciences segment to total revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicates the relative importance of a key segment to the company's strategy.

kpis.name: Personal Care Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue generated by the Personal Care segment.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the contribution of the Personal Care segment to total revenue.
kpis.signal: Highlights growth or contraction in an important market segment.

kpis.name: Specialty Additives Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue generated by the Specialty Additives segment.
kpis.description: This KPI shows the contribution of the Specialty Additives segment to total revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicates stability or momentum in the specialty additives segment.

kpis.name: AI-related Cloud Deals Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud deals that include AI capabilities.
kpis.description: Measures the integration of AI capabilities into the company's cloud offerings.
kpis.signal: Indicator of AI adoption in cloud solutions.

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
kpis.explanation: Total volume of calls made to artificial intelligence application programming interfaces (APIs).
kpis.description: This KPI tracks AI service usage via API calls, reflecting customer engagement.
kpis.signal: Early indicator of AI service usage and adoption.

risks.title: Tariffs and Global Trade Policy Uncertainty
risks.description: Fiscal 2025 saw increased regulatory activity involving notable changes to U.S. and foreign trade policy, leading to significant uncertainty in the macroeconomic and geopolitical environments.

risks.title: Geopolitical Conflicts Impact
risks.description: Business disruptions related to ongoing conflicts between Israel/Iran, Ukraine/Russia, and Israel/Hamas continue to impact businesses around the globe.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in Ashland's 10-K filing. Ashland focuses on specialty additives and ingredients for traditional markets.
